prs.body:

prs.title: perf(kit): use `package-manager-detector` to install packages
prs.author: danielroe
prs.body:
### 🔗 Linked issue

https://github.com/nuxt/cli/pull/1580

### 📚 Description

this migrates us to `package-manager-detector`, which is a [tiny library](https://npmx.dev/package/package-manager-detector) for resolving pms + install commands and isn't dependent on corepack, so it plays nice with node 26+

... and just like nypm, it supports `npm`, `yarn`, `pnpm`, `deno`, `bun`, `nub`, and `aube`...
